description:
The surah that opens with the oath of the Divine One swearing by the **The Morning Brightness** and the night when all falls still. It is named after "the morning brightness" (ḍūḥā), mentioned in verse 1. The surah is an address to the Prophet Muḥammad, to reassure him, when he had not received revelation for some time, that his Lord had not forsaken him.
The surah is also known as Daylight, Early Hours of Morning, Morning Bright, Morning Light, The Forenoon, The Glorious Morning Light, The Morning

translations.2: by the night when it is calm!
translations.3:
_Your_ Lord has neither forsaken _you_
  nor is He displeased with _you_,
translations.4: and the Hereafter shall be better for _you_ than the world.
translations.5:
Soon _your_ Lord will give _you_ [that with which]
 _you_ will be pleased.
translations.6: Did He not find _you_ an orphan, and shelter _you_?
translations.7: Did He not find _you_ astray, and guide _you_?
translations.8: Did He not find _you_ needy, and enrich _you_?
translations.9: So, as for the orphan, do not oppress him;
translations.10: and as for the beggar, do not chide him;
translations.11:
and as for _your_ Lord's blessing,
  proclaim it!
